nodes.name: architecture-diagram.html
nodes.summary: Static HTML content fragment rendering a five-service system architecture diagram (React frontend, FastAPI backend, Redis queue, Celery worker, PostgreSQL+pgvector) for the document upload/RAG ingestion pipeline, including an SSE notification flow walkthrough and a docker-compose service breakdown. Produced as a visual mockup during a superpowers brainstorming session.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure inline-styled HTML with no scripting; used as a rendered artifact rather than an application view.

nodes.name: architecture-options.html
nodes.summary: Static HTML content fragment presenting three candidate backend architectures for the RAG document upload pipeline — FastAPI+asyncio BackgroundTasks with Postgres job tracking (recommended), FastAPI+Celery+Redis, and FastAPI+Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY — each with pros/cons and a service diagram, used in an interactive brainstorming decision UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes an inline onclick handler (toggleSelect) for selectable option cards, but no accompanying script is defined in this fragment.

nodes.name: composer-ui.html
nodes.summary: Static HTML mockup of the chat Composer UI showing the proposed upload button placement, a selected-file chip, and a bottom-right toast notification for completed document ingestion, plus a summary list of new frontend/backend files needed to implement the upload feature.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely presentational mockup markup (inline SVG icons and styles) mirroring the intended Composer.jsx layout, not the actual component implementation.
